entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To pull up your account, could I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
It's order number 775-B-493. I don't see what the big deal is, I want to send it back. The box is unopened and everything. Just process the return.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloFit Aero helmet purchased on 2025-11-03. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the wrong color! It looked completely different online and I'm not wearing this thing. Just give me my money back. If you don't, I'm writing a review on every website I can find. I want to speak to your manager.

I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Your satisfaction is very important to us. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item.
You'd better. I'm not paying for something I'll never use.

Okay, I've reviewed the policy. Since you received the helmet 32 days ago, it falls well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now. Getting the right gear is critical, especially when it comes to your safety.
Oh. So you can do it? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that makes it even simpler. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email address on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay. That's... great. I appreciate that. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
